meta.name: prisma-upgrade-v7
meta.description: Complete migration guide from Prisma ORM v6 to v7 covering all breaking changes. Use when upgrading Prisma versions, encountering v7 errors, or migrating existing projects. Triggers on "upgrade to prisma 7", "prisma 7 migration", "prisma-client generator", "driver adapter required".

copy.tagline: 把 Prisma 项目从 v6 升到 v7,按清单改完所有破坏性变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目用 Prisma ORM 想升到 v7,却被各种破坏性变更卡住
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade a Prisma project from v6 to v7 by working through every breaking change
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project uses Prisma ORM and you're stuck on v7 breaking changes

howto.what: 它会按 Prisma 6 升 7 的迁移清单逐项改项目：generator 换成 prisma-client、更新 tsconfig、新建 prisma.config.ts、装 driver adapter、改客户端导入与实例化。MongoDB 项目不适用。
howto.when: 当你从 Prisma v6 升到 v7、升级后遇到报错，或提到 “prisma 7 migration” 等关键词时接管。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目的 Prisma 从 6 升级到 7
say.note: 按迁移步骤逐项改动并说明原因

say.text: 我的 Prisma 7 项目报 Cannot find module，帮我查一下
say.note: 对照 generator 的 output 路径与导入路径

say.text: Prisma 7 用 SQL 数据库要装哪个 driver adapter？
say.note: 按数据库类型给出对应的适配器包

howto.what_en: Guides your Prisma 6→7 migration: switch the generator to prisma-client, update tsconfig, add prisma.config.ts, install a driver adapter, and fix client imports and instantiation. MongoDB not covered.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you upgrade from Prisma v6 to v7, hit errors after upgrading, or mention "prisma 7 migration" and similar keywords.

say_en.text: Upgrade this project's Prisma from v6 to v7
say_en.note: Walks the migration steps and explains each change

say_en.text: My Prisma 7 app throws Cannot find module - help me debug
say_en.note: Checks the generator output path against imports

say_en.text: Which driver adapter do I need for SQL in Prisma 7?
say_en.note: Names the adapter package for your database
